Asian Games 2026: Indian Athletes Secure Medals Amidst Records and Struggles

At the Asian Games 2026, Indian athletes have secured several medals. Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu ended a 12-year wait for an Asian Games medal by winning silver, expressing emotional joy. The Indian women's kabaddi team defeated Iran, and the men's team beat Bangladesh. India's skeet team, including Maheshwari Chauhan, won a historic bronze medal under tough conditions. However, the Indian men's badminton team lost 3-1 to China in the semi-finals, with Shi Yuqi and Li Shifeng defeating Lakshya Sen and Ayush Shetty, despite Satwik-Chirag beating World Champions Liang and Wang. Manu Bhaker finished fifth in the 10m Air Pistol final, and the team also underperformed. In other events, Qatar's Nasser Al-Attiyah won gold in shooting, the same year he won the Dakar Rally. North Korea's weightlifter set three world records for a gold medal. China's 13-year-old swimmer Yu Zidi won her third gold medal in the 400m individual medley, setting an Asian Games record. An Afghan cyclist, who reportedly disguised herself as a man, won a silver medal after years of struggle.
